author: Thomas Ryan
ai_role: research assistance only; not an author
outcome_firewall: No new FlyVis checkpoint or biological-model candidate outcome may be opened in this gate.
claim_target: A finite black-box intervention battery can falsify but cannot certify uniform causal replacement fidelity over a continuous admissible domain unless structural, regularity-and-coverage, or distributional assumptions are added.
frozen_falsifiers: exact replacement must return zero discrepancy and certify
hidden output-unobservable mismatch must not inflate interface error
reachable but untested piecewise-linear region must match every battery trajectory yet force fail-closed coverage status
unreachable mismatch must not be treated as required evidence for the declared reachable domain
stable non-normal recurrence must amplify a small local discrepancy
regular coverage must beat an equal-budget random battery by the frozen fill-distance ratio
adversarial witness search must remain downstream of battery construction
advance_rules: all frozen falsifiers behave in their declared directions
the finite-test impossibility witness is continuous piecewise linear and exactly zero on every tested state-input pair
the Lipschitz fill-distance upper bound contains the adversarial witness and refuses the causal-equivalence threshold
the regular battery fill distance is no more than 0.75 times the median equal-budget random fill distance
the contribution is framed as an operational synthesis of inherited mathematics, not a new realization, bisimulation, verification, or optimal-recovery theorem
kill_rules: kill if the method claims universal equivalence from held-out empirical success
kill if source-reachable samples are silently treated as a candidate-inclusive invariant tube
kill if an estimated or local Lipschitz constant is presented as a sound global bound
kill if the paper implies consciousness, identity, survival, or biological replaceability
kill if exact prior art already states the same claim-audit framework for neural replacement or whole-brain-emulation fidelity
